title: "Genomic Release Filter Concept"
format: html

```{python}
#| label: setup
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

from _lib import (
    DATA_DIR,
    load_par_visit_candids,
    load_identifiers,
    load_excluded_release_candids,
    load_additional_excluded_pscids,
)

try:
    from matplotlib_venn import venn2, venn3
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    HAS_VENN = True
except ImportError:
    HAS_VENN = False

# ── data sources ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
identifiers = load_identifiers()
par_candids = load_par_visit_candids()
exc_rc = load_excluded_release_candids()
add_exc_pscids = load_additional_excluded_pscids()

hbcd_fam_raw = pd.read_csv(
    str(DATA_DIR / ".." / "HST_HBCD_Transfer_July2025" / "HBCD_analysis" / "hbcd.fam"),
    sep=r"\s+",
    header=None,
    names=["FID", "IID", "PAT", "MAT", "SEX", "PHENO"],
)
hbcd_fam_raw["pscid"] = hbcd_fam_raw["IID"].astype(str).str[-10:-1]

# ── deduplicate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
identifiers = identifiers.drop_duplicates(subset="release_candid")

hbcd_with_rc = hbcd_fam_raw.merge(
    identifiers[["pscid", "release_candid"]].drop_duplicates(subset="pscid"),
    on="pscid",
    how="left",
)

id_rc = set(identifiers["release_candid"].unique())
hbcd_rc = set(hbcd_with_rc["release_candid"].dropna().unique())
add_exc_rc = set(
    identifiers.loc[identifiers["pscid"].isin(add_exc_pscids), "release_candid"]
    .dropna()
    .astype(int)
    .unique()
)

# exclusion lists (individual)
excl_csv = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "HBCDexclusions.csv")
excl_lists = {}
for col in excl_csv.columns:
    pscids = set(excl_csv[col].dropna().astype(str).str.strip())
    pscids = {p for p in pscids if p and p != "nan"}
    excl_lists[col] = pscids

# map each list to release_candid
excl_rc_lists = {}
for name, pscids in excl_lists.items():
    excl_rc_lists[name] = set(
        identifiers.loc[identifiers["pscid"].isin(pscids), "release_candid"]
        .dropna()
        .astype(int)
        .unique()
    )

# combined exclusion RC
all_exc_rc = exc_rc | add_exc_rc

# pscid → candid mapping
pscid_to_candid = (
    identifiers[["pscid", "candid"]]
    .dropna(subset=["candid"])
    .drop_duplicates(subset="pscid")
    .set_index("pscid")["candid"]
    .astype(int)
    .to_dict()
)
```

```{python}
#| label: cardinality-overview
print("Set sizes (release_candid level)")
print("═" * 60)
print(f"  identifiers                   : {len(id_rc):>6}")
print(f"  hbcd.fam (HST, excl FID=0)    : {len(hbcd_rc):>6}")
print(f"  par_visit (completed visits)   : {len(par_candids):>6}")
print(f"  excluded (Excel, RC)           : {len(exc_rc):>6}")
print(f"  excluded (HBCDexclusions.csv)  : {len(add_exc_pscids):>6} pscids")
print(f"  → mapped to RC                 : {len(add_exc_rc):>6}")
print(f"  combined exclusions            : {len(all_exc_rc):>6}")
print()
print(f"  identifiers ∩ hbcd.fam         : {len(id_rc & hbcd_rc):>6}")
print(f"  identifiers ∩ par_visit        : {len(id_rc & par_candids):>6}")
print(f"  hbcd.fam ∩ par_visit           : {len(hbcd_rc & par_candids):>6}")
print()
triple = id_rc & hbcd_rc & par_candids
print(f"  identifiers ∩ hbcd.fam ∩ pv    : {len(triple):>6}")
print(f"    minus all exclusions         : {len(triple - all_exc_rc):>6}")
```

---

## Venn 1: Identifiers vs hbcd.fam

Overlap between identifiers (release_candid) and hbcd.fam (release_candid from FID).

```{python}
#| label: venn-identifiers-vs-fam
#| fig-cap: Release_candid overlap between identifiers and hbcd.fam
if HAS_VENN:
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6))
    v = venn2(
        subsets=(len(id_rc - hbcd_rc), len(hbcd_rc - id_rc), len(id_rc & hbcd_rc)),
        set_labels=("identifiers", "hbcd.fam"),
        set_colors=["#1f78b4", "#e31a1c"],
        ax=ax,
    )
    ax.set_title("Identifiers ∩ hbcd.fam (release_candid)", fontsize=13)
    from matplotlib.patches import Patch
    ax.legend(
        handles=[
            Patch(facecolor="#1f78b4", alpha=0.5, label="identifiers"),
            Patch(facecolor="#e31a1c", alpha=0.5, label="hbcd.fam"),
        ],
        loc="lower left",
        fontsize=9,
    )
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
else:
    print("matplotlib-venn not available")
```

---

## Exclusion Lists vs par_visit

Each exclusion list's pscids are mapped to `candid` via identifiers, then checked against par_visit. Zero overlap is expected.

```{python}
#| label: exclusion-parvisit-table
print(f"par_visit candids  : {len(par_candids)}")
print()
print(f"Exclusion lists    : {len(excl_lists)}\n")

for name, pscids in excl_lists.items():
    mapped = {p: pscid_to_candid.get(p) for p in pscids}
    mapped_candids = {c for c in mapped.values() if c is not None}
    missing = {p for p, c in mapped.items() if c is None}
    overlap = mapped_candids & par_candids
    pct = len(overlap) / len(mapped_candids) * 100 if mapped_candids else 0

    status = "OK" if not overlap else "OVERLAP"
    print(f"  [{status:>7}] {name}")
    print(f"           list pscids          : {len(pscids):>6}")
    print(f"           mapped to candid     : {len(mapped_candids):>6}")
    if missing:
        print(f"           unmapped pscids      : {len(missing):>6}")
    print(f"           in par_visit         : {len(overlap):>6}  ({pct:.0f}%)")
    if overlap:
        print(f"           overlapping candids  : {sorted(overlap)[:15]}")
    print()
```

---

## Venn 2: Overlap Between the Three Exclusion Lists

How many pscids are shared across the three exclusion criteria?

```{python}
#| label: venn-exclusion-lists
#| fig-cap: Pscid-level overlap between the three exclusion lists
if HAS_VENN:
    lists_names = list(excl_lists.keys())
    s0 = excl_lists[lists_names[0]]
    s1 = excl_lists[lists_names[1]]
    s2 = excl_lists[lists_names[2]]

    subsets = (
        len(s0 - s1 - s2),
        len(s1 - s0 - s2),
        len((s0 & s1) - s2),
        len(s2 - s0 - s1),
        len((s0 & s2) - s1),
        len((s1 & s2) - s0),
        len(s0 & s1 & s2),
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))
    v = venn3(
        subsets,
        set_labels=[n.split(":")[0] for n in lists_names],
        set_colors=["#1f78b4", "#e31a1c", "#33a02c"],
        ax=ax,
    )
    ax.set_title("Exclusion list pscid overlap", fontsize=13)
    from matplotlib.patches import Patch
    ax.legend(
        handles=[
            Patch(facecolor="#1f78b4", alpha=0.5, label=lists_names[0]),
            Patch(facecolor="#e31a1c", alpha=0.5, label=lists_names[1]),
            Patch(facecolor="#33a02c", alpha=0.5, label=lists_names[2]),
        ],
        loc="lower left",
        fontsize=8,
    )
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
else:
    print("matplotlib-venn not available")
```

---

## Venn 3: Combined Exclusions vs hbcd.fam vs par_visit

All three exclusion lists are combined at the `release_candid` level and compared against hbcd.fam and par_visit.

```{python}
#| label: venn-combined
#| fig-cap: Combined exclusions vs hbcd.fam vs par_visit
if HAS_VENN:
    subsets = (
        len(all_exc_rc - hbcd_rc - par_candids),
        len(hbcd_rc - all_exc_rc - par_candids),
        len((all_exc_rc & hbcd_rc) - par_candids),
        len(par_candids - all_exc_rc - hbcd_rc),
        len((all_exc_rc & par_candids) - hbcd_rc),
        len((hbcd_rc & par_candids) - all_exc_rc),
        len(all_exc_rc & hbcd_rc & par_candids),
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))
    v = venn3(
        subsets,
        set_labels=("Excluded (RC)", "hbcd.fam", "par_visit"),
        set_colors=["#ff7f00", "#1f78b4", "#33a02c"],
        ax=ax,
    )
    ax.set_title("Combined exclusions ∩ hbcd.fam ∩ par_visit", fontsize=13)
    from matplotlib.patches import Patch
    ax.legend(
        handles=[
            Patch(facecolor="#ff7f00", alpha=0.5, label="Excluded (RC)"),
            Patch(facecolor="#1f78b4", alpha=0.5, label="hbcd.fam"),
            Patch(facecolor="#33a02c", alpha=0.5, label="par_visit"),
        ],
        loc="lower left",
        fontsize=9,
    )
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
else:
    print("matplotlib-venn not available")
```
